summary.problem: Setting 'context.fileFiltering.customIgnoreFilePaths' to directory paths (such as 'node_modules/') breaks '@' path completion in the CLI.
summary.root_cause: IgnoreFileParser.getIgnoreFilePaths() uses fs.existsSync(filePath) to identify ignore files. When customIgnoreFilePaths contains directory paths that exist on disk, fs.existsSync returns true, causing getIgnoreFilePaths() to return directory paths. Subsequently, loadIgnoreRules() attempts to read the directory as a file via fs.readFileSync(), throwing an unhandled EISDIR error that crashes FileSearch initialization and causes @ completion to fail.
summary.context: During @ completion initialization in useAtCompletion.ts, FileSearchFactory initializes file searchers using FileDiscoveryService. loadIgnoreRules() reads ignore rules from all paths returned by FileDiscoveryService.getAllIgnoreFilePaths(). If any path is a directory rather than a file, readFileSync fails with EISDIR.

steps: In packages/core/src/utils/ignoreFileParser.ts, update getIgnoreFilePaths() to check that the path exists and is a file using fs.statSync(filePath).isFile() (safely caught for errors) instead of only fs.existsSync(filePath).

In packages/core/src/utils/filesearch/ignore.ts, update loadIgnoreRules() to verify that each ignore file path is a file before calling fs.readFileSync, and wrap fs.readFileSync in a try/catch block to handle reading errors gracefully.
In packages/core/src/services/fileDiscoveryService.ts, ensure getIgnoreFilePaths() and getAllIgnoreFilePaths() filter out non-file paths.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: When customIgnoreFilePaths contains directory paths that exist on disk, getIgnoreFilePaths() ignores directories and only returns valid files, and loadIgnoreRules() completes without EISDIR exceptions.
verification_steps: Add unit tests in packages/core/src/utils/ignoreFileParser.test.ts verifying that getIgnoreFilePaths() returns only files and excludes existing directories.
Add unit tests in packages/core/src/utils/filesearch/ignore.test.ts verifying that loadIgnoreRules() handles existing directory paths without throwing EISDIR.
Run Vitest tests to ensure all tests pass successfully.
